title: Weekly active users for a retention report
prompt: The growth team tracks weekly retention. Given an events table (user_id, week), write a query returning each week and its count of distinct active users, ordered by week. Columns: week, active_users.
setupSql:
CREATE TABLE events (user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, week INTEGER NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO events (user_id, week) VALUES (1, 1), (2, 1), (3, 1), (1, 2), (3, 2), (3, 2);
referenceSql: SELECT week, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users FROM events GROUP BY week ORDER BY week;

tests.name: reference solution produces the weekly active counts
tests.sql: SELECT week, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users FROM events GROUP BY week ORDER BY week;

tests.name: seed sanity: six raw events
tests.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM events;
